body: Drain keeps its signature; ReportingDrainer.DrainWithReport (CapDrainReport) lists finished and cut-off attempts with a disposition (requeued, cancelled, engine-owned). DrainOutcome is the one decision function. ubgo/shutdown is not imported (absent here; core is stdlib-only); ShutdownHook returns a plain func(ctx) error any phased manager can register. Forward and failover forward DrainWithReport.
title: Drain report and neutral shutdown hook
